_what_this_is: Human-owned invocation policy for microduck_rl. Two gates: the factory never merges, and the factory never spends money on a GPU. .factory/policy.py enforces both against a proposed workflow invocation, a proposed shell command, or a schedule file. Protected: only a human commit changes it.
_the_money_gate: There is no local CUDA device, so every training run goes through Hugging Face Jobs at the l4x1 flavor and bills a real card. `uv run train` is the launcher and `--hf-jobs` is the flag that makes it remote. AGENTS.md also requires a 64-env/5-iteration smoke test before any long run -- that smoke test is itself a training run and is also a human act. MISSION.md hard invariant 1: the factory may prepare a run, argue for it, and write down exactly what to type. A person types it.
_the_merge_gate: archon-merge-queue ends in `merge-approved-prs`, which runs gh with the repository owner's token; `approve` mode still has the factory perform the merge. Both are refused here, as in the duckfactory installation.
_command_pattern_note: Substring matches against a proposed shell command. `uv run train` is the launcher even without --hf-jobs -- a local run would still need a GPU this machine does not have, and a smoke test is a training run. `uv run play` and `uv run publish` are here for a different reason: play needs a trained checkpoint and publish pushes a policy to the Hub where the robot daemon loads it. Neither is destructive on its own; both are outside what the factory does.
_standard_path_note: Issue to reviewed pull request. Everything this factory does happens before a merge and before a GPU.
